decision.reason: [ev-5b5fdbd0eddf] is a one-line entry in the release's list of new features. It names the capability and the two kinds (Bucket, Provider), but it does not say whether the feature is opt-in or whether existing Bucket and Provider authentication behaves differently after the upgrade. The section context ([ev-80bfde0826d4], [ev-b335114fe89c] and others) is other one-line feature entries, and no upgrade-guide text about this subject is shown, so "none" is not stated by the evidence; it is inferred from the "new features" heading. To decide, we need upstream text (such as an upgrade guide, API docs or controller changelog) saying how the feature is enabled (for example a new spec field or feature gate) and that existing objects are unaffected unless they opt in.
